Zapata County communities along the Rio Grande are monitoring the river as loose buoys continue to drift downstream. The issue has prompted local officials and residents to track buoy locations and assess any potential environmental or navigation risks. The incident is reported by KGNS and is part of ongoing river monitoring efforts in the border region.
